description.en:
Job input. For details, see [Input details](~~29253~~).

> - In ApsaraVideo Media Processing APIs, the Object value must be URL-encoded using UTF-8 encoding.

- The OSS region must match the region where MPS is deployed.

description.zh:

- 遵守OSS Bucket定义，更多信息请参见[基本概念](~~31827~~)。
description.en:
The OSS bucket where output files are stored.

- Follows the OSS bucket definition. For more information, see [Terms](~~31827~~).

description.zh:
输出文件所在的OSS Bucket的地域（OSS Region）。
- OSS Bucket必须与媒体处理服务在同一个地域。
- 遵守OSS Bucket定义，更多信息请参见[基本概念](~~31827~~)。
description.en:
The OSS region (OSS Region) where the output bucket resides.

- The OSS bucket must be in the same region as the ApsaraVideo Media Processing service.

- Follows the OSS bucket definition. For more information, see [Terms](~~31827~~).

description.zh:
作业输出配置。详细说明，请参见[Output详情](~~29253~~)。
-  Outputs由Output列表构成，JSON数组，大小上限为30。
description.en:
Job output configurations. For details, see [Output details](~~29253~~).

- Outputs is a JSON array of Output objects. The maximum size is 30.

description.zh:
管道ID。更多信息，请参见[基本概念](~~31827~~)。

- 可以通过[MPS控制台](https://mps.console.aliyun.com/overview) > **全局设置** > **管道及回调**查询。

- 如果需要异步通知，请为管道绑定MNS消息。详细操作，请参见<props="china">[接收消息通知](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42618.html)</props><props="intl">[接收消息通知](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/apsaravideo-for-media-processing/latest/receive-message-notifications)</props>。
description.en:
The pipeline ID. For more information, see [Terms](~~31827~~).

- You can find it in the [MPS console](https://mps.console.aliyun.com/overview) > **Settings** > **Pipelines and callbacks**.

- To receive asynchronous notifications, bind an MNS message topic to the pipeline. For details, see <props="china">[Receive message notifications](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42618.html)</props><props="intl">[Receive message notifications](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/apsaravideo-for-media-processing/latest/receive-message-notifications)</props>.

descriptions.zh:
- 转码作业为[异步执行作业](~~3027615~~)，不保证时效性。在提交转码作业后，任务会添加到管道中排队，被调度执行。所以在接口返回时，不保证转码已经完成。执行完成后需要调用[查询转码作业](~~602836~~)接口轮询执行结果，或通过为管道绑定MNS消息接收执行结果，详细操作请参见<props="china">[接收消息通知](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42618.html)</props><props="intl">[接收消息通知](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/apsaravideo-for-media-processing/latest/receive-message-notifications)</props>。

- 输入单个文件大小最大支持100 GB，超过可能导致执行失败。
- 使用**预置智能模板**对输入文件进行转码时，必须要先调用提交预置模板分析作业接口（[SubmitAnalysisJob](~~29223~~)），分析作业成功完成后可以通过调用查询模板分析作业接口（ [QueryAnalysisJobList](~~29224~~)）获取该输入文件的可用预置模板列表。在提交转码作业时，将TemplateId参数设置为可用的预置模板ID即可。若提交的转码作业中指定的模板不在可用的预置模板列表中，会导致转码作业失败。
- 使用**预置静态模板**对输入文件进行转码时，不需要提交模板分析作业。

- 如需在MPS服务中使用多个账号，可以为阿里云账号创建RAM用户，详细说明请参见[创建RAM用户并授权](~~42841~~)。如果提交转码作业和查询转码作业使用的是不同的阿里云账号，则会导致查询不到数据。

<props="china">- 如果您的账户已经欠费，欠费后24小时内会暂停服务。更多信息请参见[欠费说明](~~29203~~)。</props>

- 更多转码常见问题，请参见[媒体处理常见问题](~~38986~~)。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342832~~)。
descriptions.en:
- Transcoding jobs are [asynchronous jobs](~~3027615~~). They are not guaranteed to be executed immediately. After you submit a transcoding job, it is added to an MPS queue and waits for scheduling. Therefore, the API response does not indicate that the transcoding is complete. To check the result, you can call the [QueryTranscodeJobList](~~602836~~) operation to poll for the status, or configure MNS message notifications for the queue. For more information, see <props="china">[Receive message notifications](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42618.html)</props><props="intl">[Receive message notifications](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/apsaravideo-for-media-processing/latest/receive-message-notifications)</props>.

- The maximum size of a single input file is 100 GB. Larger files may cause the job to fail.

- To transcode an input file using a **preset intelligent template**, first call the SubmitAnalysisJob operation ([SubmitAnalysisJob](~~29223~~)) to submit a template analysis job. After the analysis job is successful, call the QueryAnalysisJobList operation ([QueryAnalysisJobList](~~29224~~)) to retrieve the list of available preset templates for the input file. When you submit the transcoding job, set the TemplateId parameter to one of the available preset template IDs. If the specified template is not in the list of available preset templates, the transcoding job fails.

- To transcode an input file using a **preset static template**, you do not need to submit a template analysis job.

- To use multiple Alibaba Cloud accounts with MPS, you can create RAM users for your Alibaba Cloud account. For more information, see [Create a RAM user and grant permissions](~~42841~~). If you submit and query a transcoding job using different Alibaba Cloud accounts, no data is returned in the query results.

<props="china">

- If your account has overdue payments, your service is suspended within 24 hours after the due date. For more information, see [Overdue payments](~~29203~~).

</props>


- For answers to frequently asked questions about transcoding, see the [ApsaraVideo Media Processing FAQ](~~38986~~).

## QPS limit

The QPS limit for this operation is 100 requests per second per user. Exceeding this limit triggers rate limiting, which may affect your business. Call this operation accordingly. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~342832~~).
